title: Gerente financeiro
description:
Amorha está auxiliando um cliente com vaga aberta de gerente financeiro, no segmento de Alimentação no Rio de Janeiro. ATENÇÃO SÓ CANDIDATURAS DO SEGMENTO DE ALIMENTAÇÃO SERÃO AVALIADAS.
Gerente de Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A)
Responsável por estruturar orçamentos, prever cenários (forecasts), analisar variações de desempenho e apoiar decisões estratégicas com relatórios precisos.
Atuar no monitoramento de fluxo de caixa, controle de custos e alocação de recursos, sendo crucial para a saúde financeira e crescimento da empresa, geralmente exigindo sólida formação em finanças ou administração.
Responsabilidades:
Planejamento Orçamentário: Elaborar o planejamento orçamentário anual (Budget) e revisões periódicas (Forecast).
Análise de Variações: Analisar o orçado vs. realizado (Variação Orçamentária), identificando desvios e propondo planos de ação.
Gestão de Tesouraria/Fluxo de Caixa: Supervisionar contas a pagar/receber e o fluxo de caixa para garantir a liquidez.
Relatórios Estratégicos: Criar relatórios de performance (KPIs) para a alta administração, suportando a tomada de decisão.
Modelagem Financeira: Analisar cenários de investimentos, corte de gastos e melhoria do desempenho econômico.
Qualificações:
Superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou Engenharia, com pós-graduação ou MBA na área financeira.
Habilidades: Forte capacidade analítica, visão estratégica, conhecimento em ERPs (ex: SAP, Oracle);
Excel avançado.
Mais de 2 anos na função de gestão Financeiro e de Planejamento, com experiência tanto na operação diária e tesouraria, quanto no Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A) foca na estratégia, orçamentos e visão de longo prazo.

description:

Requisitos:

Atividades:

  • Verificar quais quartos disponíveis para internação, utilizando relatório CENSO OCUPACIONAL, como base de informação, bem como inspecionar os quartos verificando se apresentam as condições necessárias de utilização, visando liberar os mesmos no sistema POSTHOS.
  • Efetuar a forração dos quartos, providenciando a colocação de lençóis nas camas, fronhas no travesseiro e demais itens de forração;
  • Inspecionar os quartos após a alta do paciente e com o serviço de limpeza e higienização devidamente realizado, conferindo o local com base nos itens listados no check list, a fim de garantir que o quarto esteja em perfeitas condições para uma nova internação;
  • Após a internação dos pacientes, prestar informações diversas e orientações aos familiares e acompanhantes dos mesmos sobre as funcionalidades disponíveis na suíte, como utilização de aparelhos televisores, formas de utilização de redes telefônicas, como encaminhar críticas e sugestões, onde encontrar e como requerer peças adicionais de enxovais, entre outras, a fim de garantir a adequada ambientação dos pacientes e seus familiares/acompanhantes;
  • Inspecionar todos os dispensers do hospital, garantindo que todos estejam funcionando perfeitamente;
  • Acompanhar semanalmente a empresa terceirizada Ecolab, garantindo que todos os setores do hospital sejam deditizados;
  • Recolher todos os pertences achados e perdidos do hospital, solicitação de guarda, sempre em saco lacrado, garantindo segurança no recolhimento e entrega dos mesmos;
  • "Atender a empresa terceirizada de resíduos, bem como emitir os manifestos, e garantir a segurança na coleta dos resíduos.
    Auxiliar nas inspeções das áreas e apoiar no transporte e remoção de mobiliário e itens do setor, quando necessário.

  • Escala de trabalho: X :00 - 19:00 - DIUR B

Conheça a empresa Rede D'Or


Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

Se você é uma pessoa qualificada, de perfil inovador e sintonizada com o que há de mais atual em sua área de atuação, junte-se à nossa equipe.

Oferecemos mais que vagas de trabalho, oferecemos oportunidades para você fazer a diferença.

description:
Azzas 2154 | Fashion & Lifestyle Men

Somos uma unidade de negócio do grupo Azzas 2154. Dedicada à moda e ao lifestyle masculino, reunimos marcas que são referência no mercado: Reserva, Oficina, Foxton, Mini, INK e Go.

Nascemos da evolução do grupo AR&CO e, hoje, fazemos parte de um movimento histórico e sem precedentes que consolidou o Azzas 2154 como o maior grupo de moda da América Latina, com 27 marcas que unem inovação, identidade e desejo.

Seguimos construindo o futuro da moda masculina com propósito, autenticidade e orgulho de fazer parte de algo maior.

Somos Reserva, Oficina, Foxton, Go, Mini e INK.

Somos todos Azzas 2154.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Vaga: Analista de Planejamento Comercial Junior

Local: Botafogo - Rio de Janeiro

O Analista de Planejamento Comercial Júnior é responsável por apoiar a construção e o monitoramento do plano de vendas e estoques da marca. Atuando de forma analítica e operacional, seu papel é garantir que as metas comerciais sejam desdobradas em planos de ação viáveis, conectando dados de performance histórica com as projeções de mercado do segmento de moda athleisure. Ele contribui para decisões mais eficientes através do suporte ao controle de OTB (Open to Buy) e da saúde do giro de estoque.

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Suporte ao Planejamento de Vendas: Apoiar a construção de metas e orçamentos comerciais, utilizando dados históricos e indicadores de mercado para projetar cenários.
  • Monitoramento de Indicadores (KPIs): Acompanhar diariamente os resultados de vendas, margem, giro e cobertura de estoque, gerando análises para identificar oportunidades ou desvios.
  • Gestão de Estoque e OTB: Contribuir para o controle do orçamento de compras (Open to Buy), garantindo que o fluxo de entrada de produtos esteja alinhado à demanda e à capacidade financeira.
  • Interface com Áreas Parceiras: Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Compras, Estilo, Marketing e Operações, garantindo que o planejamento comercial esteja refletido na execução das coleções.
  • Organização de Relatórios e Dashboards: Apoiar a manutenção de planilhas, relatórios de performance e apresentações mensais de resultados para a diretoria.
  • Acompanhamento de Mercado: Monitorar o comportamento do consumidor de moda esportiva e a performance da concorrência, sugerindo ajustes em remarcações (markdown) ou ações promocionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência prévia (incluindo estágio) em planejamento comercial, planejamento de compras ou inteligência de mercado, preferencialmente no varejo de moda.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Forte capacidade analítica, domínio avançado de Excel e habilidade no manuseio de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Perfil organizado, colaborativo e com alto nível de atenção aos detalhes, essencial para o controle preciso de estoques e metas.
  • Formação: Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Moda (com foco em gestão) ou áreas correlatas.

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em planejamento de coleções para marcas de Athleisure ou vestuário esportivo.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau) ou sistemas de gestão comercial (ERP).
  • Experiência com planejamento integrado para canais físicos e e-commerce (Omnichannel).
  • Capacidade de atuar como suporte técnico para as ferramentas de análise de dados do time.

Nascemos da moda, mas nossa história nunca foi apenas sobre roupa. Criados com um propósito, somos movidos por coragem, inovação e coração. Aqui, nossa essência tem voz, o orgulho pulsa e a mente está sempre aberta. Valorizamos quem soma com respeito, provoca com empatia e acredita que é o diferente que transforma, porque é na diversidade que a gente se fortalece.

The Operations Department of MSF OCB (Operational Centre Brussels) is made up of 8 managerial and technical teams called Cells or Regional Support Teams (RST), each in charge of a portfolio of countries and 1 Emergency Team (E-Unit) for the management of intense emergency interventions. These teams directly supervise and support the implementation on the projects.

The Regional Support Team (RST5) is a team of 6 people based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil and a regional pharmacy advisor working remotely. It is planned to transfer Haiti from the Cell 3 portfolio to the RST5 portfolio from the second quarter of 2025. The countries currently managed by the RST 5 are: Brazil and Venezuela. The countries are indicative, as a re-shuffling of the portfolio within the Operations department occurs on a regular basis.

As a Medical Officer (MO), you will play a key medical role in the operations of RST 5. You support the Medical Coordinators to safeguard the medical quality of the projects. It is a critical position to ensure a strong overview and support in the preparation and implementation of our projects.

In terms of scope, your support will be focused on the Haiti project, with particular emphasis on hospital management and on supporting local teams with international medical orders. You will also provide specific assistance to other projects in the RST5 portfolio, most probably Venezuela, due to the important supply challenge.

You will report to the Regional Medical Team Leader of RST5 and functionally linked to the Medical Operational Manager in the Medical Department of OCB.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES


The core function is to enhance and optimize the operational support and guidance of the projects, ensuring achievable and context-adapted quality of care.

Strategy Implementation Planning

  • Co-define and co-design the Medical Operations (MedOps) strategy implementation with the medical coordination teams and the Regional Medical Team Leader of RST5
  • Provide strategic input, leadership, and guidance to ensure plans are practical, achievable, and aligned with the medical priorities within the countries of interventions, in coordination with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Strategic Oversight and Monitoring

  • Ensure comprehensive monitoring and follow-up of the implementation of the medical strategy in all MSF operations through regular and ad hoc support to the medical coordination's

Project Implementation

  • Provide regular support to medical coordinators in the follow-up and implementation of projects in coordination with the Regional Medical Team Leader
  • Offer ad-hoc support as needed, ensuring that medical coordinators have the resources and assistance they need in agreement with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Policies and Guidelines Management

  • Ensure that medical resources, policies, and guidelines are relevant, appropriate, available, and effectively managed in the countries of interventions
  • Regularly interact and coordinate with the medical referents to ensure that policies, guidelines, and guidance adapted/tailored to the medical operations and specific project's context and objectives

Quality of Care (QoC) implementation

  • Ensure and actively monitor the implementation of Quality of Care (QoC) standards and improvement plans across all projects
  • Guide the medical teams in the programs to develop and enforce quality monitoring and improvement initiatives

Medical Activity Analysis

  • Responsible for monitoring and analyzing medical activities and ensuring data-driven decision-making in collaboration with the Regional Medical Team Leader
  • Review and analyze medical reports and data, providing constructive feedback and involving the medical referent as required

Tool improvement and development

  • Propose improvements to existing management and tracking tools (dashboards and internal control mechanisms, etc.) that are user-friendly, effective and context adapted to enhance the oversight of medical programs

Medical stock strategy and management

  • Oversee the review, planning, and validation of the medical standard list and medical forecasts, including emergency preparedness (EPREP)
  • Revise and validate medical orders within the agreed framework (budget, activity scope, medical master, and standard list, etc.)
  • Define the medical stock management strategy and monitor its implementation (e.g., GSDP: "Good Storage and Distribution Practices", SoP's: "Standard Operating Procedures", etc.) in collaboration with the supply officer and project teams

Human Resources planning and management

  • Oversee the regular follow-up of projects' human resource needs, including the review and planning of HR requirements, together with the Regional Medical Team Leader
  • Ensure effective matching and follow-up with the Human Resources Officer (HRO) and Pool Managers (PMs), including the briefing and debriefing of key medical operations staff in the countries of RST 5, in agreement with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Budget

  • Ensure cost-awareness in medical decision-making, balancing quality of care with resources availability, context specificity and sustainability, in collaboration with the Regional Medical Team Leader
  • Participate in medical operations (MedOps) budget planning and management to ensure efficient allocation of resources for medical operations

Emergency Response

  • Participate in the medical support/guidance to the projects for emergency responses together with the Regional Medical Team Leader and medical department referents
  • Ensure rapid and effective deployment of resources and personnel in the event of emergencies in the countries of interventions of RST 5, in collaboration with the Regional Medical Team Leader

EPREP

  • Ensure that the Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan (EPREP), and scenarios are regularly updated and adapted to the evolving contexts in collaboration with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Technical Files

  • Provide first-line follow-up and input on technical files, according to specific expertise and in consultation with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Staff Health

  • Review and validate health policies for both International Mobile Staff (IMS) and Locally Hired Staff (LHS), ensuring comprehensive and effective healthcare provisions
  • Facilitate the management of staff health files between the countries of interventions and the Staff Health Unit (SHU) (including medical evacuations) in coordination with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Coordination with medical department

  • Engage with medical referents bilaterally or lead group discussions/working groups to support projects and enhance collaboration
  • Facilitate effective communication and coordination between medical field teams and the medical department
  • Participate in medical department meetings, in relevant circles and in MedOps meetings, contributing to department strategies with updates from the programs, and reverting relevant information's to the country teams

Communication and Information flow

  • Promote open communication and information flow within the RST, the medical department, and the countries of interventions of RST 5 on all MedOps-related issues
  • Maintain transparency and alignment across teams to foster a collaborative operational environment

Replace the RST5 Regional Medical Team Leader during absences or upon request, ensuring continuity of medical technical and strategic decision-making.

REQUIREMENTS


Education & Experience

  • Medical or paramedical degree
  • Minimum 3 years of MSF international experience
  • Minimum 1 year experience as Medical Coordinator, including projects focusing on secondary health care
  • Experience in hospital management is a must
  • Degree in Public Health or Epidemiology and/or basic knowledge of Humanitarian law is an asset
  • Experience in epidemics, public health, IDPs (Internal Displaced populations) and refugees, emergency responses are an asset

Competencies

  • Planning and organizing
  • Strategic vision/oversight
  • Negotiation and networking
  • Coaching & mirroring with the teams
  • Teamwork and cooperation
  • Comprehensive knowledge of humanitarian interventions
  • Results and quality orientation
  • Able to set priorities, make choices, and assume decisions
  • Strong cross-cultural awareness and adaptability

Languages

  • Excellent command of French and English is mandatory (oral and written)
  • Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese isa a strong asset

CONDITIONS

  • Expected starting date: March 2025
  • Location: Rio de Janeiro (Brazil)
  • Mobility: minimum 30% in the countries of interventions of RST5
  • Contract type: Fixed-term contract – Full time
  • Contract duration: 12 months (extendable)
  • Salary and benefits according to MSF-OCB international grid for non-residents in Brazil and MSF Brazil grid for residents in Brazil
  • Family position, conditions according to hosting entity's policy
  • When in Rio de Janeiro, possibility of 2 days homeworking per week, to be defined locally
  • Adhere to the MSF principles and to our managerial values: Respect, Transparency, Integrity, Accountability, Trust and Empowerment
  • Adhere to the MSF Adherence to the MSF Behavioural Commitments

Deadline for applications: 09/02/2025

Sobre a Posição: Seu Impacto como Assistente de Audiovisual

Nesta posição, você terá a oportunidade de aplicar o valor de Crescimento e Inovação, utilizando ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial e novas tendências de vídeo para facilitar o entendimento das nossas soluções de tecnologia.

Sua missão será fortalecer a autoridade das nossas unidades de negócio no mercado de infraestrutura e ISPs, atuando de ponta a ponta: desde a cobertura de eventos até a criação de vídeos dinâmicos para redes sociais e anúncios.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como parte do time, você terá autonomia para criar e produzir. Suas principais atividades incluirão:

  • Criação de Roteiros e Conceitos: Colaborar com a equipe utilizando ferramentas de IA (como ChatGPT ou Gemini) para estruturar roteiros técnicos com linguagem clara e atraente.
  • Produção e Captação: Realizar a captação de imagem e som para vídeos de produtos (unboxing, reviews) e entrevistas com especialistas internos.
  • Conteúdo para Redes Sociais e Ads: Adaptar gravações para formatos curtos e dinâmicos (Reels, Shorts, TikTok) focados em engajamento, bem como criar criativos focados em conversão para Ads.
  • Mobile Video Making: Aplicar agilidade (valor de Velocidade) na captação e edição via smartphone, utilizando CapCut e estabilizadores mobile.

  • Cobertura de Eventos: Registrar treinamentos, workshops e feiras do setor para a criação de aftermovies e depoimentos.
  • Suporte em Transmissões: Auxiliar na montagem técnica e operação de Lives e Webinars para lançamentos e fins educativos.
  • Organização: Gerenciar o acervo de imagens e vídeos, garantindo acessibilidade dos materiais para todo o time de marketing.

Requisitos e qualificações

Para ter sucesso nesta posição, buscamos um perfil proativo, organizado e com facilidade para lidar com temas técnicos:

  • Formação: Graduação em Cinema, Rádio e TV, Publicidade, Design ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Conhecimento prévio em captação e edição de vídeo (aceitamos portfólio acadêmico ou projetos freelance).
  • Softwares: Domínio de Adobe Premiere Pro e CapCut. Conhecimento básico em After Effects, Photoshop e ferramentas de IA para vídeo (como Veo 3, Enhance Speech, etc.).
  • Equipamento: Familiaridade com câmeras DSLR/Mirrorless, áudio (lapela), iluminação de estúdio/externa e gravação mobile.

Diferenciais que brilham aos nossos olhos:

  • Conhecimento básico ou interesse genuíno pelo setor de tecnologia e telecomunicações17.
  • Experiência com pilotagem e captação com drones

Informações adicionais

  • Pacote de benefícios abrangente: Salário competitivo, SulAmérica Saúde e Dental, Icatu Seguros, Swile (TotalPass) e PLR.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo: Oportunidades de crescimento e plano de desenvolvimento individual (PDI), com treinamentos e capacitações internas alinhados às suas metas.
  • Cultura de inovação: Atue em um ambiente que respira Atitude Digital e Velocidade , com desafios constantes que promovem o seu Espírito Empreendedor .
  • Jornada híbrida: Modelo de trabalho híbrido, com auxílio mensal de R$ 100,00 para apoiar o home office.
  • Ambiente colaborativo: Faça parte de um time que pratica o Respeito e a Colaboração , onde suas ideias são valorizadas.
  • Programas exclusivos: Participe dos nossos programas internos como #SuperInfluencers e #SuperIndicações, fortalecendo nossa cultura e o engajamento.

Em 13 anos de existência, a Supercomm já se solidificou no setor de tecnologia, oferecendo soluções práticas, acessíveis e de alta qualidade em diferentes segmentos do mercado.

Nossa empresa, valoriza o trabalho em equipe, a inovação e o compromisso com a excelência. Se você busca um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, com oportunidades de aprendizado contínuo e projetos desafiadores, venha fazer parte do nosso #SUPERTIME

Fundada em 2003 no Rio de Janeiro, a MACNOR MARINE atua no mercado marítimo e offshore, oferecendo soluções, equipamentos e serviços de engenharia de alta qualidade. Atuará em interface direta com Operações, RH, SGI/HSE, Financeiro, clínicas ocupacionais, fornecedores e clientes, assegurando previsibilidade e agilidade nas escalas e movimentações.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar e executar a logística de mobilização/desmobilização de colaboradores para bases, clientes, atendimentos externos e embarques;
  • Organizar e controlar escala/agenda de atendimentos e embarques, remanejamentos e priorização conforme demanda da Operação;
  • Garantir conformidade e atualização de documentação obrigatória para acesso a clientes (ex.: ASO, treinamentos/NRS, certificados, comprovação de vínculo, plano de saúde, documentos pessoais, requisitos do cliente);

  • Solicitar e acompanhar passagens, hospedagens, traslados e transporte corporativo, garantindo aderência à política interna e aos prazos;
  • Manter controles atualizados (sistema/planilhas/portais), com checklist de mobilização por colaborador e status por atendimento/projeto;
  • Apoiar na gestão de custos de mobilização (centros de custo, rateios, justificativas), em interface com o Financeiro;
  • Apoiar o time operacional em mudanças emergenciais (alterações de escala, cancelamentos, trocas de voo, reprogramações e imprevistos);
  • Manter comunicação ativa com colaboradores mobilizados (orientações de viagem, horários, documentos, ponto de encontro) e com a liderança;
  • Elaborar/atualizar relatórios de controle (pendências documentais, indicadores de mobilização, custos de viagem e ocorrências);
  • Garantir cumprimento de normas internas e requisitos de SGI aplicáveis à mobilização e embarque.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Logística, Recursos Humanos, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com logística de pessoal, mobilização, viagens corporativas, controle documental ou rotinas administrativas/operacionais;
  • Perfil organizado, com forte senso de prioridade, capacidade de atuar sob pressão, lidar com urgências e mudanças de última hora;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces (Operações, RH, HSE, clientes e fornecedores);
  • Conhecimento de Pacote Office, especialmente Excel (controles, filtros, PROCV, tabelas dinâmicas);
  • Disponibilidade para eventuais acionamentos fora do horário comercial em períodos críticos de mobilização/embarque;
  • Residir com fácil acesso a Niterói – RJ.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com portais e exigências documentais de clientes (cadastros, uploads, validações);

title: Americas Credit Associate
description:
About Us

GSCF | | Rio de Janeiro – Brazil (Hybrid)

GSCF is a leading fintech company in the working capital finance space, serving some of the largest tech manufacturers globally. By funding, structuring, and servicing accounts receivables portfolios for our customers, we help companies get the most out of their working capital. We help our customers grow their sales, strengthen their balance sheets, and eliminate risk.

Our formation in 2021 gives us a start-up culture and mindset, while our origins bring deep industry knowledge, extensive specialized expertise , and geographic reach across 59 countries. Despite being a new player in our space, GSCF serviced more than $60 billion in tech accounts receivables volumes in 2021. We are wholly owned and funded by Blackstone, the world's largest alternative asset manager, which provides us with a large and flexible funding pool, significant relationships, and strategic guidance.

Our field, global working capital finance, represents a $5.5 trillion total addressable market that is expected to grow an additional 50% by 2026, driven by increased supply chain complexity, digitization of the invoicing process and growing demand for longer payment terms. Our aim is to become the global leader in the working capital finance space.

GSCF is a global employer with more than 300 employees across 20+ countries.

The role:

The GSCF Americas Credit Associate reports directly to the GSCF Americas Credit Officer. The role includes performing full analysis of customers' financial statements and proposed deal structures, preparing recommendations with adequate terms and conditions for decision makers to facilitate the credit assessment process. It also holds a credit delegation level reflecting the experience and the seniority of the associate.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Responsible for credit risk assessments of GSCF transactions for assigned markets in the Americas.

  • Assess existing and potential new obligors , ensuring a balanced approach to credit risk while pursuing GSCF's revenue and profit targets and minimizing bad debts.

  • Perform full credit assessments of customers and proposed deal structures.

  • Prepare recommendations throughout submission of rating rationale with adequate terms and conditions for decision makers.

  • Manage the credit portfolio , actively engaging with Sales and Operations on credit-related items.

  • Operate within reasonable turnaround times to support business needs.

  • Work in a small team of credit experts , fostering collaboration and communication across the region and various GSCF functions.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Fluent English and Portuguese, plus fluent or proficient in Spanish required for the specific markets/clients for which you would be directly responsible ;

  • Bachelor or university degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics;

  • Work experience: minimum 3 years working in a Credit Underwriter , Banking, Finance, or Financial Analytical role, preferably within a bank or multinational environment;

  • Proficiency in Office 365 with focus on Excel and PowerPoint;

  • Excellent analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills;

  • Motivation to succeed and drive results in a fast-paced, growing environment;

Ability to identify and address challenges and think "outside the box" to recommend solutions to support the business within acceptable risk parameter .

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by law.

title: Venue Technology Manager
description:

Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s)
Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s)
Collaborate with stakeholders' groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure
Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations)
Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process)
Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables
Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Commercial, Football Technology etc.
Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams
Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build-out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of tournament venues
In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services.
Identify and report on the progress of all critical dependencies in accordance with the reporting methodologies
Manage the asset tracking and management of deployed technology equipment
Track the progress of structural build-out and IT implementation leading up to the timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and final decommissioning of the venues
Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems
Follow-up with various stakeholders, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring delivery of technology services / dependencies as per agreed requirements, service levels etc.
Support and ensure the team adhere to the IT Service management protocols
Ensure positive attitude from the Venue Technology teams and good relationship with all the parties, including FIFA teams, Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) areas/projects, end-users, suppliers, Host Country/ City counterparts
Manage the on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to Technology Command Centre.

title: Tecnico de AC/Refrigeracao Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Refrigeração com foco marítimo que vai atuar na instalação, comissionamento, manutenção e reparo de chillers, plantas de provisão, unidades de refrigeração e sistemas HVAC especificamente projetados para ambientes marítimos. Este papel exige um conhecimento profundo de sistemas de refrigeração complexos e uma forte habilidade para gerenciar os desafios técnicos únicos dos sistemas de refrigeração.
Responsabilidades Principais
Instalar, comissionar e manter chillers industriais, plantas de refrigeração de provisão e sistemas HVAC em embarcações marítimas e em instalações marítimas.
Realizar manutenção rotineira e de emergência em sistemas de refrigeração e ar condicionado, garantindo que operem com eficiência máxima e atendam aos padrões ambientais e de segurança.
Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em uma variedade de sistemas, focando em chillers e unidades de refrigeração, enquanto mantém proficiência com componentes de sistemas HVAC.
Reformar compressores e outros componentes críticos dentro desses sistemas, melhorando sua confiabilidade e desempenho.
Colaborar com engenheiros marítimos para otimizar layouts e cronogramas de refrigeração, minimizando o tempo de inatividade e a interferência operacional.
Manter documentação precisa e detalhada de todos os procedimentos técnicos, modificações de sistemas e verificações de conformidade.
Fornecer orientação e treinamento especializados para técnicos juniores, enfatizando as especificidades de chillers, plantas de provisão e sistemas de refrigeração em um contexto marítimo.
Manter-se atualizado com os avanços tecnológicos em sistemas de refrigeração marítima e HVAC, integrando novas técnicas e equipamentos em estruturas existentes.
Qualificações
Experiência como Técnico de Refrigeração com conhecimento especializado em refrigeração, incluindo chillers, plantas de provisão e unidades de refrigeração em grande escala.
Proficiência na instalação, comissionamento, diagnóstico de problemas e reforma de sistemas de refrigeração complexos, com experiência adicional em tecnologias HVAC.
Certificações relevantes em Refrigeração e HVAC, com treinamento ou certificações adicionais voltadas para aplicações marítimas, são preferidas.
Fortes habilidades técnicas, incluindo a capacidade de interpretar esquemas detalhados e manuais operacionais específicos para sistemas de refrigeração e HVAC marítimos.
Habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas, com foco na resolução rápida e eficiente de questões técnicas em ambientes marítimos desafiadores.
Inglês intermediário, e um diferencial
Disposição para viajar por longos períodos, se necessário.
Proficiência na utilização de ferramentas como MS Office ( Word, Excel) para realização de relatórios técnicos e de serviço.
Condições De Trabalho
Este papel exige trabalhar em variados ambientes marítimos, que podem ser fisicamente exigentes e às vezes perigosos. Os técnicos precisam se adaptar às condições restritas e dinâmicas encontradas em navios e instalações portuárias. Horários de trabalho flexíveis, incluindo possíveis turnos noturnos e de fim de semana, são frequentemente necessários para acomodar os cronogramas operacionais dos clientes marítimos.

title: Procurement Assistant
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe Procurement Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference, supporting the administrative and procurement implementation of projects and initiatives. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the Operational Team of UN-Habitat in Rio de Janeiro and HQs.
Work LocationRio de Janeiro, RJ, Brazil
Expected durationSix (6) months, with possibility of renewal
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. To meet with greater demand for projects' implementation, the office of Rio de Janeiro is looking for a Procurement Assistant that will be focusing on Brazil initiatives. The professional will be asked to assist the office team by contributing to the administrative and procurement of projects and initiatives. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Procurement Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Procurement Assistant will support the implementation of the projects in Brazil, with the following responsibilities: a. Support the administrative implementation of projects and initiatives, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures. b. Support procurement processes for goods, services, and works, ensuring full compliance with organizational procurement rules, policies, and ethical standards. c. Plan, manage, and monitor procurement activities in line with approved project workplans, budgets, and timelines under supervision. d. Support the preparation of procurement documentation, including solicitation documents, evaluations, contracts, and purchase orders. e. Support procurement planning with programme, finance, and operations teams to ensure timely delivery and budget alignment. f. Help vendor sourcing, market research, and supplier evaluations to ensure value for money, transparency, and fairness. g. Monitor contract implementation, including deliverables, timelines, amendments, and closure, in coordination with relevant units. h. Maintain accurate and complete procurement records and ensure proper filing in corporate systems. i. Provide guidance and technical support to programme teams on procurement procedures and requirements. j. Identify procurement risks and propose mitigation measures to strengthen compliance and efficiency. k. Contribute to continuous improvement of procurement processes, tools, and templates. l. Assist in budget planning, monitoring, and revisions, including tracking expenditures against approved budgets, specially in relation to procurement. m. Support and follow up on financial transactions, such as payments, advances, reimbursements, and vendor contracts. n. Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial and administrative records for projects and operations. o. Organize and archive all documents and information relevant to project administration. p. Support the team through audits and other administrative and financial compliance checks. q. Monitor financial reporting timelines and contribute to the preparation of financial reports for internal and external stakeholders. r. Support audits and financial reviews by ensuring availability and organization of required documentation. s. Be responsible of for inventory and warehouse management. t. Write official letters in Portuguese. u. Be responsible for keeping information organized and accessible. v. Participate in missions as requested. w. Carry out other activities requested by the Head of Office and/or Program Officer within the framework of this consultancy, without prejudice to fulfilling their responsibilities. m. Prepare reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. n. Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Procurement Assistant shall support the Program Officers in the proper planning and management of programmes' implementation related to the office's project portfolio, according to the stated responsibilities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation
Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Public Administration, Administration, Economics, or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience
A minimum of three (3) years of experience in program' implementation and projects in public administration or international organizations, administrative and financial issues, and/or related areas is required.
Demonstrated experience in administrative and finance is required.
Work experience within the United Nations System is desirable.
International experience is desirable, particularly in the field of international cooperation for development, urban development, and project management. Skills
Good computer skills in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) are required.
Mastery of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is required.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and/or Spanish is desirable.
Additional InformationTravel details: The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration SB-3 UNDP Brazil Salary Scale Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the "Candidate Profile" (CP) at Inspira:
Cover memo (maximum 1 page)
Educational Background (incl. dates)
Professional Experience (assignments, tasks, achievements, duration by years/ months)
Expertise and preferences regarding location of potential assignments
Other Experience and Expertise (e.g. Internships/ voluntary work, etc.)* * Please note that Internships, self-employment and part-time count as 50%. In addition to it, note experience not relevant to the position will not be considered. All applications should be submitted to: Inspira UN-HABITAT does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process. title: Specialist II, Finance
description:
Job Description
The Finance Specialist II performs general accounting duties of a clerical nature, update and maintain financial records, reconcile general ledger accounts, and manage the accounting databases, including the preparation and recording of journal entries into the accounting system and providing administrative support, running reports for management, and recording a wide range of financial transactions.
What You Will Do:
Provides administrative and bookkeeping assistance for the preparation of financial reports and confirming the accuracy of the accounting information.
Preparation of accounting/financial transactions using financial systems and tools.
Receiving and recording vouchers, entries, remittances, and other transactions.
Checking for accuracy in reports, account balances, and postings.
Accurately enter key data in our systems in support of the accounting function.
Provide information used to prepare regular and ad hoc management reports and spreadsheets.
Reconciling and reporting any discrepancies found in the accounting records.
Maintain records and document financial processes.
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience
High school diploma or equivalent
Three (3) to five (5) years of experience, including financial and accounting experience.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Demonstrates a willingness to learn and assume responsibilities.
Knowledge of computer tools, consisting primarily of Microsoft applications.
Understanding of financial reporting systems, general ledger, and the related processes.
Ability to identify and analyze errors and mis-posting through tools available for data mining.
Good communication skills, as well as the ability to interact with team members, and the ability to communicate directly with management team members.
Pro-active skills to identify causes for errors and potential risk areas.
Ability to obtain working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management Systems.
Reporting Relationships:
The incumbent reports to the Manager of Finance. This position does not have any direct reports.
About Us
We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.
ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We're at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

title: GameMaker Developer
description:
Magic Media is a pioneering media, entertainment, and tech group powered by creativity and innovation. We have a physical presence in 15 countries and expertise in the areas of art, animation, cybersecurity, game development, software development, VFX, and video production amongst others. We work with leading developers and publishers within the games and tech industry, providing support and solutions designed around individual needs and carried out by global experts.

We're looking for an experienced GameMaker Developer with a strong background in console porting to join our international team. The ideal candidate will have solid professional experience using GameMaker in a production environment, with a focus on adapting and optimizing games for console platforms. In this role, you'll be responsible for front-end gameplay development, including design implementation, coding, testing, and debugging, while also contributing to task estimation and the creation of technical documentation to support the development process.

WHAT YOU WILL DO: 

  • Work on different projects for different platforms including mobile, PC and console.
  • Work on projects from scratch, potentially ongoing projects and porting.
  • Fix bugs, prepare documentation.
  • Interact and communicate with everyone in the team, eventually even clients.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience as a GameMaker Developer.
  • A passion for video games.
  • Strong expertise in GameMaker, with hands-on experience porting GameMaker games from PC to console (preferably Nintendo Switch).
  • Proven ability to optimize memory, assets, and framerate, and resolve performance bottlenecks.
  • Solid understanding of controller support, UI adaptation for consoles and certification processes.
  • Experience with the GameMaker console build pipeline, including SDK integration and packaging for submission.
  • Able to independently drive features by collaborating with cross-functional teams as needed.
  • Excellent debugging, reporting, and documentation skills.
  • Flexible and quick to adapt to new tools and technologies as required by the project.

DESIRABLE PLUSES: 

  • Familiarity with GameMaker (v2.x or GMS2+), and common extensions like Scribble, outsideTheBox, and post-processing shaders.
  • Involved in the development of at least one large game title from A-Z.
  • Experience with mobile and WebGL games.
  • Solid technical foundation (e.g. Computer Science / Maths Degree or equivalent).

Benefits

  • Permanently remote position.
  • An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of engaging projects.
  • Be part of an international group with offices worldwide.
  • Career growth and development.
  • Working closely with a team of like-minded people in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
  • Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • An inclusive culture and open communication.

At Magic Media, our passion lies in gaming. Our vision is to create and deliver engaging and interesting games for our clients. We can deliver this high-quality work on any platform, whether it be on a console, PC, or mobile. We know that reputation and results go hand-in-hand. Therefore, we work hard to find experts and talented creators to deliver the best results.

If you do not meet all the requirements, but believe you'd still be a great fit for the role, don't worry We'd still love to hear from you, please get in touch

title: Auxiliar de Frota

Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento.
Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado.

title: Senior Manager, Special Events
description:
Senior Manager, Special Events


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


Reporting to the Head of Special Events, the Senior Special Events Manager will serve as a senior leader within the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 organization. This role is a pivotal member of the Local Organizing Structure, working in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Project Team, internal functional areas, Host Cities, Commercial Affiliates, Government Authorities, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional, world-class event experiences that elevate the tournament's global impact.

Role Purpose: The Senior Special Events Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, creative development, operational execution, and overall management of all official FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 special events. The role ensures seamless, high-quality delivery aligned with FIFA's brand standards, commercial objectives, and global audience expectations.

Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament's international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-paced, and multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Strategic Event Planning & Delivery

Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of major tournament-related events, including but not limited to:

  • Oficial Dinner
  • Final Draw
  • Brand Launch
  • Mascot Launch
  • Team Workshop
  • Volunteers Kick-Off Event
  • Guest activities, when required
  • Coordination of Legends Matches
  • Participation in pre-match ceremonies
  • Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle

  • Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA's global positioning.

  • Creative Direction & Experience Design

  • Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.

  • Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.
    Ensure all events reflect the prestige, inclusivity, and global significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup.

  • Operational & Logistical Oversight

  • Manage all operational aspects including venue selection, supplier procurement, production management, accreditation, guest services, protocol, and security coordination.

  • Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.

  • Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.

  • Budget & Financial Management

  • Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.

  • Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.

  • Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.

  • Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.

  • Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.

  • Manage protocol requirements and high-profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.

  • Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.

  • Oversee external agencies and production partners, ensuring clear deliverables and performance standards.
    Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • A Master's degree (MBA) in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Additional executive education in large-scale event production, leadership, or project management is advantageous.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in large-scale international event management, preferably within global sporting events, major entertainment productions, or multinational organizations.
  • Proven experience leading high-profile, broadcast-level events such as draws, ceremonies, gala dinners, launches, or government-level functions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets and complex procurement processes.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.
  • Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with global headquarters or international governing bodies is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience within FIFA tournaments or comparable mega-events (e.g., Olympic Games, continental championships, global expos) is a strong advantage.

Skills & Competencies

Strategic & Operational Excellence

  • Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into comprehensive event delivery plans.
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously.
  • Advanced knowledge of event production, show calling, staging, audiovisual integration, and broadcast requirements.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Proven leadership capability with experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external agencies.
  • Ability to inspire, mentor, and drive high performance in fast-paced environments.
  • Strong decision-making skills under pressure.

Financial & Commercial Acumen

  • Solid budget planning, financial oversight, and cost-control expertise.
  • Understanding of sponsorship integration and brand alignment within event environments.

Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage high-level protocol and VIP relations with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is highly desirable.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven.
  • Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, multicultural environments.
  • Creative mindset with strong attention to brand experience and innovation.
  • High integrity and alignment with FIFA's values of inclusion, teamwork, and excellence.

Requiriments

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Employment Type

Fixed Term - Full Time

Location

Brazil

Workplace type

Onsite

Meet and exceed your daily KPIs and monthly targets while always finding new ways to drive impact

Keep your Salesforce pipeline organized and up to date so you're always ready to move fast
Jump in to support inbound leads and help them discover why ClassPass is the right fit
Experience You Bring:
You're based in Rio de Janeiro and energized by getting out in the field to meet local businesses
You have advanced English proficiency
You've recently stepped into sales or are ready to kick off your career in a fast-paced, growth-driven role
You're a confident communicator, someone who's never met a stranger and loves a good challenge
Organized, detail-oriented, and excited to juggle multiple priorities with ease
Resilient and open to feedback, with a passion for learning and personal growth

Driven by targets and motivated by wins, especially when they come with friendly competition

  • Preparar notas explicativas relacionadas a tributos para as Demonstrações Financeiras da empresa, garantindo transparência e precisão das informações fornecidas aos acionistas e órgãos regulatórios.
  • Comprometer-se com a melhoria contínua do desempenho empresarial, Segurança, Saúde, Meio Ambiente e Sustentabilidade. Agir sempre em conformidade com Sistema de Gestão de SSMS

description:
Sobre a vaga
Se você não aceita mediocridade ou zona de conforto, nasceu para realizar seus sonhos, com a mentalidade de pagar o preço de se desafiar a sair da zona de conforto diariamente, cosendo parte de um dream team comercial de altíssima performance, ambicioso e disciplinado, para o qual o céu é o limite, esta vaga foi feita para você

Principais Responsabilidades:
· Gerar listas de prospecção utilizando estratégias de inteligência comercial e tecnologias avançadas;
· Identificar o(s) tomador(es) de decisão na(s) empresa(s) por meio de contato telefônico, e-mail e/ou social selling, por meio das redes sociais, visando compreender suas necessidades;
· Aprimorar e captar informações comerciais fundamentais;

· Qualificar e desenvolver leads gerados por nossas estratégias de marketing;

· Cultivar relacionamentos com leads através de técnicas de social selling;
· Confirmar reuniões para os executivos de contas.
REQUISITOS DA VAGA

· Conhecimento intermediário em Google Sheets/Excel;

· Familiaridade com ferramentas de geração de leads, como LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Snovio, Lusha, etc.;
· Experiência em ferramentas de sales engagement, como Meetime, Reev, Exact Sales, e GS Engagement (Growth Machine)
· Domínio da metodologia SPIN Selling;
· Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidades de oratória e dicção.
Diferenciais:
· Prática de atividades esportivas;
· Ensino superior completo;
· Experiência prévia em empresa júnior;
· Fluência em inglês.
BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

· Remuneração: A combinar;
· Comissionamento por atingimento das metas de pré-vendas pago no mês subsequente;
· Bônus por venda fechada através do agendamento gerado pelo SDR;
· Plano de carreira com possibilidade de crescimento aceleradíssimo para Team Leader de Pré-vendas;

title: D&TD Technology Consultant
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Overview:
We are seeking a Technology Consultant to join Global Manufacturing Excellence Digitalization and Technology Division(D&TD).
Global Manufacturing Excellence is the recognized Center of Excellence driving value across Saudi Aramco's Downstream Global manufacturing portfolio. D&TD is responsible for leading the technology function collaborating across various downstream functions and corporate as well.
Your primary role is to support the development and deployment of technology management programs aimed at providing technical support across Saudi Aramco Global Manufacturing portfolio. You will ideate, introduce, deploy and sustain novel and innovative technological solutions within various domains including reliability, maintenance, sustainability, energy and process.
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Lead the end-to-end implementation of Technologies across the downstream portfolio including petrochemical facilities, refineries, terminals and bulk plants as well as gas plants.
Develop comprehensive value adding technology roadmaps aligned to business challenges such as energy optimization, sustainability, plant availability, debottlenecking and process optimization.
Accelerate technology deployment working closely with internal and external execution agencies and vendors.
Conduct feasibility studies including technical and economic evaluation of solutions, platforms, and new technologies.
Perform technologies scouting to enable the identification of innovative and value adding technologies.
Develop business case and cost/benefit analysis for technologies deployment.
Work with other consultants, engineers, and project managers to deliver comprehensive solutions that address both technical and business requirements.
Prepare reports and presentations to communicate the progress and benefits of technology initiatives to peers, relevant stakeholders and senior management.
Collaborate with technology providers in developing and conducting tailored training content and programs to support the implementation and adoption of technologies by end-users.
Recognize and introduce necessary changes to standards and governance.
Stay abreast of global and regional Oil and Gas industry trends, market conditions, and regulatory changes that may impact technology implementations.
Ensure compliance with corporate governance and standards, evaluate solution implementations. And identify necessary changes to standards and governance.
Minimum Requirements:
You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field (Chemical, Industrial, Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering). A Masters' degree is preferred.
You will have 10-15 years of experience as a Technology Consultant ideating, scouting, introducing and tracking value added technology deployment.
You have good understanding of downstream technologies, including but not limited to refinery processes.
You will have experience in developing business case and benefit/cost analysis for downstream technology.
You will have experience in working collaboratively in cross-functional teams, across the project lifecycle fostering effective communication and cooperation.
You will be able to demonstrate excellent understanding of management of change, engineering and design package as well as regulatory, risk mitigation and safety requirements.
You will have experience in change management, including developing and implementing technology changes.
You will be able to demonstrate understanding of relevant industry energy, safety and design regulations and standards ensuring compliance of proposed technology solutions.
You will be able to demonstrate excellent understanding of manufacturing technology solutions enabling the key process areas including production, reliability, environmental, safety and sustainability
You will have strong project management skills with a proven track record of successfully leading and delivering complex technology implementation projects in the O&G business
You have the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels
Working environment:
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Analista de Bem Estar Animal
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:Avaliar e monitorar constantemente as condições de alojamento, alimentação, saúde e segurança dos animais sob nossos cuidados. Colaborar com a equipe veterinária para identificar e resolver quaisquer problemas relacionados ao bem-estar animal. Elaborar e atualizar protocolos e procedimentos operacionais padrão (POPs) para garantir o cumprimento de todas as normas e regulamentações relevantes. Realizar inspeções regulares e auditorias para garantir a conformidade com os padrões de bem-estar animal. Desenvolver e implementar programas de enriquecimento ambiental e atividades que promovam o bem-estar físico e comportamental dos animais. Colaborar com a equipe de educação e conscientização para promover práticas humanitárias e a adoção responsável de animais. Participar de pesquisas, projetos e iniciativas relacionadas ao bem-estar animal em nível local e nacional. Requisitos e Qualificações:Formação superior em Medicina Veterinária, Zootecnia, Biologia ou áreas afins. Mestrado em bem-estar animal. Habilidades de análise de dados, resolução de problemas e tomada de decisões. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita. Prevenir contra invasões físicas ou lógicas e mapear todos esses procedimentos técnicos;
Instalar, configurar e atualizar softwares, esclarecendo dúvidas e fornecendo requisitos necessários para o funcionamento adequado de infraestruturas de redes;

Levantar feedbacks sobre processos visando melhoria contínua;
Zelar pelo atendimento ao usuário e por manter a lista de atendimentos dentro do SLA.
Requisitos
Windows Server: Administração de Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) e WSUS.
Linux: Administração de distribuições como Debian, CentOS, Ubuntu ou RedHat, incluindo gerenciamento de permissões, pacotes e shell scripting (Bash).
Protocolos: Domínio de TCP/IP, roteamento, sub-redes e VLANs.
Hardware: Configuração de switches (Cisco, HP, Dell), roteadores e Access Points.
Serviços: Configuração e suporte a VPN (IPsec, OpenVPN), Proxy e balanceadores de carga.
Serviços de Nuvem: Gestão de instâncias (EC2/VMs), armazenamento (S3/Blob Storage) e redes virtuais (VPC).
Virtualização: Domínio de ferramentas como VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V ou Nutanix.
Storage: Gerenciamento de storages (NAS/SAN), protocolos iSCSI, Fibre Channel e gestão de LUNs.
Firewall: Configuração de regras em soluções como Fortinet, Cisco ASA, pfSense ou SonicWall.
Backup: Implementação de políticas de retenção e ferramentas como Veeam Backup & Replication, Veritas ou Commvault.
Monitoramento: Experiência com ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana ou PRTG.
Diferenciais
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Conhecimento básico em Terraform ou Ansible.
Containers: Noções de Docker e Kubernetes.
Linguagens de Script: PowerShell ou Python para automatizar tarefas rotineiras.
Localidade da posição: Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

title: Program Manager, Grantee Experience
description:
Program Manager, Grantee Experience - Independent Contractor

Scope of Services

This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employment role. The successful contractor will provide services under a defined scope and will not be engaged as an employee.

1. Project Overview

Tilt Collective is engaging an independent contractor to provide program and grantee engagement support to strengthen relationships with partners and grantees across key portfolios. The engagement will initially focus on Brazil and US grant making, with additional support across Tilt Collective's countries and programs as required.

The Contractor will provide specialist support to enhance program implementation, strengthen compliance processes, and improve communication between Tilt Collective and its organizational partners. The Contractor will operate independently, using their own professional expertise and judgement, while collaborating with Tilt Collective stakeholders as needed to deliver the agreed services.

2. Scope of Services and Deliverables

The Contractor will provide the following services. Percentages indicate anticipated focus and do not guarantee a minimum or maximum time allocation.

A. Partner relationship management and communication (approximately 40%)

  • Act as an additional point of contact for routine partner and grantee communications, as agreed with Tilt Collective

  • Facilitate structured check-ins with partner grantees, in coordination with relevant Program Staff, to support progress tracking and issue identification

  • Coordinate translation support and cross-cultural communication requirements, particularly in Brazil

  • Support strategic communications between Tilt Collective and grantee partners
    Provide input and recommendations to help maintain productive partner relationships aligned with program objectives

B. Grant making process support (approximately 40%)

  • Support the adaptation and localisation of grant making policies, processes, and documentation to improve accessibility and contextual relevance, particularly for Brazil

  • Draft and contribute to internal grant making documents, including nomination forms and investment memos

  • Review grant proposals and provide written assessments against agreed strategic and program criteria

  • Support compliance and due diligence processes by preparing documentation and inputs as requested by the Grants Team

  • Contribute recommendations to improve grantmaking tools, procedures, and documentation

C. Additional grantee engagement and learning support (approximately 20%)

  • Support the implementation and use of MEAL tracking tools to monitor grantee progress and outcomes

  • Contribute to the preparation of progress updates and summary reports for internal or external use

  • Identify themes, trends, and learning points across grantee engagement and share insights with Tilt Collective stakeholders

3. Term and Time Commitment

The anticipated start date is as soon as reasonably practicable, with an expected commencement by Q1 2026.

The engagement is expected to average up to 20 hours per week for planning purposes. Tilt Collective guarantees a minimum commitment of 15 hours per week for the first six months of the engagement.

Hours above this level may be required by mutual agreement and in line with agreed deliverables and timelines. The Contractor retains discretion over how and when the services are performed, subject to meeting those deliverables and timelines.

4. Collaboration and Communications

The Contractor will work primarily with the Grants Director, who will serve as the primary point of contact. Regular touchpoints may be scheduled to align on priorities, deliverables, and timelines. These touchpoints are intended for coordination and information sharing and do not create a reporting or supervisory relationship.

5. Performance and Deliverables

Successful delivery will be assessed based on the quality, timeliness, and completeness of agreed outputs, including but not limited to:

  • Grant making documents produced

  • Proposal reviews and written assessments completed

  • Partner and grantee engagement activities delivered

  • Contributions to process improvement and learning

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including the Grants Team and Program or Country leadership, may be used to inform the overall assessment of the services delivered.

6. Fees and Payment

Fees will be paid monthly following submission of an invoice detailing services provided during the applicable period, in accordance with the agreed contract terms. Finance will confirm final payment mechanics separately.

Contractor Skills / Requirements

  • Necessity for fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English 

  • Location in Brazil, USA, or a similar time zone 

  • Ability to commit for six months
